name: io.github.vaquarkhan/mcp-test-suite
title: MCP Test Suite
description: Multi-language testing suite for MCP servers: declarative YAML, native adapters (Jest/JUnit/Go), and the mcp-test CLI (discovery, parallel runs, assertions, schema checks, JUnit/JSON/HTML/SARIF). Developer tooling; connects to your server process—this package is not an MCP server implementation.
